description_text: Develops and executes sales strategy for these assigned account(s) or territory. Develop strong relationships with key customer contacts and leverages to Zebra's advantage. Business Development & Sales Enablement: Lead and support the regional sales pipeline for the assigned portfolio, collaborating closely with sales teams across the APAC region Oversee the P&L of Custom Supplies (Themal Transfer Ribbon, Labels, and RFID Tags) and drive growth for the entire Supplies portfolio , fostering strong engagement with channel partners and end users Support additional product lines and drive business growth in strategic segments in collaboration with Sales and Business Units Assist in key strategic deals and customer presentations for the assigned portfolio across the APAC region Contribute to strategic sales growth initiatives Develop and implement the go-to-market strategy for the assigned portfolio across the APAC region Analyze regional market trends, competitive landscape, and customer requirements to identify growth opportunities Manage new product introductions (NPIs) for the assigned portfolio within the APAC region Provide comprehensive and structured feedback from the APAC region to global product management and engineering teams to influence future product roadmaps Preferred 3-5 years of experience in the Supplies (Themal Transfer Ribbon, Labels, and RFID Tags) industry Strong communication skills in business development and stakeholder management Self-motivated with a growth mindset Preferred Bachelor's degree in business or a related field

Responsible to resolve website errors Upload digital assets into digital asset management system and tag with appropriate metadata Maintain support pages and forms within the Adobe Experience Manager based on input from product managers, engineers, digital marketing, SEO/analytics team, sales, and other key business owners to ensure adherence to brand standards and strategic direction Lightly edit content delivered from the business for accuracy, consistency and grammar; suggest design and content improvements to better create an intuitive, consistent customer experience Continually review and optimize assets and pages to resolve any broken links, issues or bugs, and to improve search engine position ranking Participate in User Research activities around improving the Customer Self-Service experience on Zebra.com Work closely with Services and Support teams to ensure business strategy and goals are understood while creating/recommending content that bridges the gap between business requirements and user needs as per the buyers journey Work with Analytics team to pull reports and gain insights on the performance of pages and assets on the Customer Self-Service pages Preferred Work Experience (years): Minimum of 1 year of experience managing content for a high traffic website - 1+ year experience in managing content for a high traffic website - BA/BS required in Marketing, Communication, Library Sciences, Humanities, Media/Journalism or a related field - Strong attention to detail - Strong proofreading and editing skills in English - Extremely organized, ability to prioritize work and manage multiple projects at one time - Self-directed (some work will be remote); willing to try different avenues to solve problems - Basic HTML knowledge and experience with a content management system such as Adobe Experience Manager - Basic image production skills in Photoshop or similar tool None To protect candidates from falling victim to online fraudulent activity involving fake job postings and employment offers, please be aware our recruiters will always connect with you via @zebra.com email accounts. Applications are only accepted through our applicant tracking system and only accept personal identifying information through that system. Our Talent Acquisition team will not ask for you to provide personal identifying information via e-mail or outside of the system. If you are a victim of identity theft contact your local police department. This approach enhances efficiency and promotes fairness in the hiring process. However, every decision regarding interviews and hiring is made by our dedicated team, because we believe people make the best decisions about people. For more on how we use technology in hiring and how we process applicant data, see our Zebra Privacy Policy.

Pre-Sales: Support in Level of Effort (LOE) & P&L creation, contributing into contracts/Scope of Work (SOW), reviewing with our internal Legal team ready for signature. Design & Development: Design and build robust, scalable, and secure integration solutions between various enterprise systems within the project scope/contract and deliverables. Implementation: Manage the deployment and configuration of our core integration platforms. Analyzing complex system and application design problems to determine the best approach for meeting customer requirements, whether through innovative new solutions or the strategic re-use of existing components. Play a vital part in our continuous improvement process by supporting and identifying necessary change requests. Collaboration: You will be a critical link between our internal teams and field operations. You will work closely with project managers, Product Owners, Business Unit, software developers, and business analysts to gather requirements and ensure that our solutions perfectly align with customer and business goals. Furthermore, you will provide essential technical support to our Field Engineers, assisting them with the successful integration of Zebra Core Services at customer sites. Testing: Develop and execute test plans to ensure the reliability and performance of integrated systems. Troubleshooting: Identify, diagnose, and resolve integration/implementation issues in a timely manner. Documentation: Create and maintain detailed documentation for all integration processes and systems, Documenting and presenting to clients on technical solutions/designs. 2-4 years of experience in a system integration or a similar role. Proven experience with integration platforms and protocols (e.g. JSON, XML, PowerShell). Knowledge of Mobile Device Management (MDM), Android Operating Systems Basic software development and networking knowledge Experience within a client facing role is a must Excellent communications skills, ability to deal with external clients Ability to work on complex projects with minimal supervision Ability to travel across EMEA and flexibility required as and when project needs.

Lead Test Development: Complete hands-on ownership of product quality and test automation, providing technical guidance, mentorship, and support. Foster a culture of ownership, collaboration, and continuous improvement within the team. Drive Project Test Strategy: Own and define the end-to-end test strategy for major projects and releases. Collaborate with development, product, and other stakeholders to ensure comprehensive test coverage that mitigates risk. Automation Test Development: Take a leading role in the design, architecture, design, development and maintenance of our test automation frameworks. Make key technical decisions to improve efficiency, scalability, and ease of use. Champion Advanced Testing Practices: Lead the execution of complex testing scenarios, including performance, scalability, and security testing. Ensure that the team is equipped and trained to identify critical, system-level issues. Global Quality Alignment: Interface with QA leads across the globe to ensure project strategies are aligned with broader organizational quality goals and standards. Experience: 5+ years of professional experience in software quality assurance and test automation, with at least 1-2 years in a formal or informal leadership/mentorship capacity. Test Automation: Strong experience designing, building, and maintaining scalable test automation frameworks for both mobile (e.g., Appium, Espresso) and web/API (e.g., Selenium, Postman, REST Assured) applications. Platform Expertise: Proven ability to test complex, enterprise level Android and cloud-based applications, demonstrating a deep understanding of their architectures. Advanced Testing: Hands-on experience in understanding workflows, usecases, leading the design and execution of performance, load, and scalability tests. Leadership and Communication: Excellent leadership and communication skills, with a proven ability to guide a team and articulate complex technical issues to diverse audiences. Education: Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent with practical experience. Software Development Skills: Strong development experience in an object-oriented language (e.g., Java, Kotlin, Python) and the ability to read and review Android and backend cloud application code. EMM Experience: Knowledge of Enterprise Mobility Management (EMM/MDM) solutions and experience testing application behavior within managed environments. CI/CD Integration: Experience leading the integration of automated test suites into CI/CD pipelines (e.g., Jenkins, GitLab CI) to enable continuous testing. Security Testing: Familiarity with security scanning tools and a solid understanding of common application vulnerabilities. Performance Engineering: Knowledge of advanced tools and techniques for cloud and application performance profiling and optimization.

Develops and executes experiments and performance tests to assess reliability of Zebra's devices/solutions. Learns standard testing methods appropriate for use at various stages of the design and development process. Build familiarity and understanding of assigned products and product cost drivers Learns and develops proficiency with standard engineering tools Perform testing following established test plans and procedures. Completes and reports results of tests per project timelines. Perform basic data analysis Works closely with design engineers and development teams to identify critical performance parameters Develops the ability to recommend actions for maintaining test progress Provides expertise in structured test design, test set-up, metrology, data collection, data interpretation, and statistical analysis to design/project team May present test results to project team, in department management or small groups of other stakeholders Manage bug life cycle using Jira Experience testing Android services is a plus Experience with Robot Framework Automation on Android Devices, Web Automation and API Test using Python Software Testing with Mind map , Test Case design in Jira - SynapseRT Test Management Bachelor's degree 0-2 years experience Proficient with computers and experienced with basic software tools

Analyzes, develops, designs, and maintains software for the organization's products and systems. Performs system integration of software and hardware to maintain throughput and program consistency. Develops, validates, and tests: structures and user documentation. Work may be reviewed for accuracy and overall adequacy. Develop and Maintain Features: Write clean, readable, and maintainable code for new and existing features in our enterprise Android applications using Kotlin and Java. Contribute to Technical Solutions: Assist in the implementation of features involving UI, background services, APIs, and inter-application communication under the guidance of senior engineers. Contribute to the Full Development Lifecycle: Participate in all phases of development, from feature design discussions and implementation to writing unit tests, end to end testing and assisting with deployment. Work with Backend Systems: Integrate with backend services by consuming RESTful APIs and ensuring reliable data exchange. Assist in Optimizing Performance: Help identify and fix bugs, and assist in profiling and improving application performance, memory usage, and battery life. Experience: 2+ years of professional experience in native Android application development. Core Skills: Solid programming skills in Kotlin and/or Java, with a good understanding of the Android SDK and fundamental Android Jetpack components. Architectural Expertise: Familiarity with modern architectural patterns such as MVVM or MVI. Android Components: Knowledge of the Android application lifecycle, services, and common components for building user interfaces and handling data. API & Security: Experience consuming RESTful APIs and an understanding of basic secure coding practices. Testing: Experience writing unit tests using frameworks like JUnit and Mockito. Problem-Solving: Good troubleshooting, analytical, and logical skills, with a strong desire to learn and collaborate. Education: Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent with practical experience. Full-Stack Interest: An interest in or some experience with backend API development or database management. Peripheral Integration: Familiarity with NFC, Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE), or other device communication technologies.

Conduct market research and competitive analysis to identify and qualify new business opportunities within the hospitality and large retail sectors. Collaborate with senior sales managers to help develop and execute strategic plans for account growth. Actively support the sales cycle by assisting with the preparation of proposals, presentations, and solution demonstrations. Provide operational support for strategic accounts by coordinating with internal sales, marketing, and technical teams on customer projects. Help build and maintain relationships with key stakeholders by supporting customers onboarding, workshops, and ongoing communication. Ensure accurate tracking of account activities and sales data within the CRM system. Bachelor's or Master's degree in Business Administration, International Business, Sales or Marketing, Technology, or a related field 1-2 years of experience in business development, sales support, account management, or retail/hospitality technology. Internship experience in the technology or retail sectors is a plus. Fluency in German and business-level proficiency in English are essential. Knowledge of retail technology, POS systems, or mobile computing solutions, familiarity with CRM systems (e.g., Salesforce) and experience working with large enterprise accounts is an advantage Strong communication and presentation skills Interest in enterprise technology solutions

Collect and review all payroll-related data, such as timesheets, new hire information and employee changes for your designated payroll. Ensure the data is processed accurately and in timely manner, cooperate with external and internal parties to meet agreed deadlines. Provide documentation for accounting entries and ensure their accuracy. Follow-up on any identified discrepancies. Cooperate with Payroll providers to ensure Tax, Social security and other payments are made and reporting produced accurately and in a timely manner. Ensure that internal controls and processes are followed. Liaise with employees, People team and payroll providers on any payroll issues in coordination with senior team members. Act as an owner of your assigned duties, communicate issues or escalate in timely manner to the senior team members or direct supervisor Backup other Payroll team members when required Maintain strict confidentiality of all records High school diploma is advantage Requires less than 1 year of experience Must be highly organized, detail minded, and able to analyze complex payroll transactions Ability to communicate effectively both oral and written with a customer service approach Ability to work within a team environment and possess skills to support process change Competency in spreadsheet and word processing applications

Manage outbound orders in WMS system including task management. Monitors and ensures team adherence to operation procedures. Coordinate and communicate effectively across departments. Has the ability to run required daily reports and coordinate work strategies for all associates. Performs outbound staging and packing in accordance with site policies. Executes ERP system transactions on outbound and inbound shipments. Updates FMS for parcel and freight shipments. Learns to use handheld RF scanners and Warehouse Management System to fulfill orders. Maintains inventory accuracy. Handles and controls hazardous material on both inbound and outbound. Complies with 5S safety, housekeeping practices, and regulations. Completes all required safety training and follows protocol in all risk situations. Uses Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) appropriate to tasks at hand. Lifts up to 75 pounds unassisted. Certification on powered industrial trucks including work assist vehicle (WAV), off the ground order picker (up to 35' off the ground), reach truck, dock stocker and powered pallet jacks. Creates repair RMA's, manages receiving and shipment issues within repair systems. Develops familiarity with a subset of products, processes, operational metrics and software tools; learns and follows basic work instructions for functional assignments according to productivity and quality standards Provides input geared towards continuous improvement, work instruction documentation, and standardization of processes. Resolves a variety of basic problems of limited complexity under direct supervision and performs rudimentary analysis involving a limited number of factors. Creates expense orders for internal repair consumption. Services customer product, including evaluating and validating customer complaint information, repair history, troubleshooting, and contract entitlement. Creates work instructions, check sheets, or other process documentation. Trains associates in basic work assignments and shares information with the team in regards to new learnings. May obtain training in other areas of safety (i.e. fire extinguisher use). Possesses full product knowledge within a subset of a product families. Solid understanding of Lean Manufacturing concepts (i.e. types of waste, cycle and takt time, Kanban, kaizen, FIFO, JIT, Poka yoke, line balancing, etc). Performs work method analysis and develops best practices for a variety of operations along with setting standard work times. Learns and develops ability to analyze data from reports to make business decisions related to work force utilization (i.e. line balancing, OT, etc). Ability to develop accurate and detailed work method documentation. Learns and develops familiarity with the concepts of basic statistics (i.e. normal distribution, variance, and basic SPC) and can apply them to business needs. Demonstrates innovative and creative ideas in managing safety in the workplace. Leads by example in terms of safe working behaviors and in emergency situations (i.e. fire alarm evacuations). Learns and develops knowledge of industry standards for operational safety topics (i.e. handling hazardous materials and chemicals). Develops and implements corrective actions in response to safety and 5S audit findings. Understands the goals, objectives, and priorities of other areas of the department and supports to align resources to those priorities. Develops training content and or courses and delivers training to other associates. Assists logistics leaders with daily work load management, employee communications, and other leadership aspects of the operation. Works on a full range of problems of moderate scope that require selection and/or modification of existing procedures and processes. Represents the unit on project teams and may perform in project leadership role on projects of moderate scope and impact. Resolves a diverse range of moderately complex problems where analysis of data requires evaluation of a variety of moderately complex factors. Typically required to interpret and frame information for presentation to varied audiences. Typically has contact with internal or external stakeholders in order to resolve moderately complex problems. Full knowledge of ISO requirements and demonstrated ability to ensure compliance with external auditors. Basic computer literacy, with knowledge of software including Microsoft Office, Warehouse Management systems, and ERP system. Full knowledge of job-related policies and procedures as well as corporate policies and procedures that may impact role functioning. Requires full knowledge of own area of functional responsibility. Effectively distributes work, providing performance guidance as needed. Proficient understanding of the use of a desktop Can read a ruler. Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) Required (safety glasses, steel-toed boots, gloves, etc.) Work for a company that cares, offers a growth environment, and a culture of respect, inclusion and recognition - our front-line workers have an average 7-year tenure!
